Text.Text: The school no longer holds the forge. Keep your timing sharper than your grudges. You've finished my Forcebane trials. I have no further work for you here.
These trials require rank 50 in Spear. Reach it before you hunt trained Force users. Timing matters more than ambition.

Someone in the Forge Caverns is teaching my counters to the people they were built against. Recover their ledger so I can trace the school. Defeat six Forcebane Adepts in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Forcebane Forge Heat Ledger; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples. I'll give you the Korriban Forge Caverns Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Forcebane.

Here's the Korriban Forge Caverns Key. Use 'Forge Caverns' in Korriban, Sith Fortress, Forgeworks. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Forcebane Adepts, then return with the Forcebane Forge Heat Ledger.

Rule one, and carve it somewhere you'll see it: reach ends ritual. A sorcerer needs a breath to call the storm down. A spear crosses four meters in less. Forcebane isn't mysticism, it's arithmetic with a point on the end. Timing, distance, iron. The forge decides whether your arithmetic holds when the other side cheats.

Use 'Forge Caverns' in Korriban, Sith Fortress, Forgeworks. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Forcebane Adepts in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Forcebane Forge Heat Ledger; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples.

Smiths who trained as soldiers and pray like Sith. The adepts fight in pairs and they don't break when the first one drops. Keep your point moving, kill the chanting ones first, and don't let the forge floor pick your footing for you.
Defeat six Forcebane Adepts in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Forcebane Forge Heat Ledger; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples.
You've defeated six Forcebane Adepts. Let me see the Forcebane Forge Heat Ledger.
The training record is back. We can see what went wrong. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are refining those counters with a tempering matrix. Bring it back before their work spreads. Defeat five Forcebane Specialists in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Forcebane Sith Tempering Matrix; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Forge Caverns. Defeat five Forcebane Specialists to secure the Forcebane Sith Tempering Matrix, then return to me.

A quench-frame. You seat a blade in it while the alloy sets, and whatever the frame holds, the steel remembers. Mine held angles and timing. Theirs holds Sith alchemy, so the metal remembers hate instead. If that sounds like mysticism to you, it is, and that's exactly why I want it on my bench and not theirs.

That's the question with a knife in it. Somebody who drilled under me is standing down there in better robes, drawing my forms on their chalkboards. The ledger's rosters were student handwriting. I trained maybe a dozen people who could teach this. The matrix will tell me which one turned.

Specialists don't drill in pairs, they drill with an audience of apprentices who join in uninvited. Expect the fight you planned plus half of one you didn't. Kill the specialist first and the audience remembers other appointments.
Defeat five Forcebane Specialists in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Forcebane Sith Tempering Matrix; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples.
You've defeated five Forcebane Specialists. Let me see the Forcebane Sith Tempering Matrix.
That equipment no longer serves their drills. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

Their warden protects the tempering line. Recover his anvil sigil and break that defense. Defeat the Forcebane Warden in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Forcebane Cracked Anvil Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Forge Caverns, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Forcebane Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Forcebane Cracked Anvil Sigil.

He was the first one the turncoat trained, and the best. The sigil says the deep forge answers to him: quench lines, apprentices, all of it. He's felt every form I teach coming since before you learned to hold a spear level. That's what different means. Nothing you do will surprise him. Do it anyway, in numbers.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Forcebane Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Past the tempering line the floor is slag channels and the light is whatever's burning. The warden likes it there because crowds don't follow. Be the crowd anyway. And if he offers to let your friends leave so long as you face him alone, that's not honor, that's him doing arithmetic too.

Defeat the Forcebane Warden in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Forcebane Cracked Anvil Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Forcebane Warden. Let me see the Forcebane Cracked Anvil Sigil.
The warden's watch is over. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four overseers still authorize the school's work. Take their clearance token. Defeat four members of the Forcebane Inner Circle in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Forcebane Overseer's Clearance Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Forge Caverns. Defeat four members of the Forcebane Inner Circle to secure the Forcebane Overseer's Clearance Token, then return to me.

Two smiths, a quartermaster, and a duelist who thinks she's my equal. All four drilled under the turncoat, which means all four drilled under me, once removed. They know my forms the way you know your own signature. So don't write your signature down there. Write something new.

Every crate of tempered blades leaving that forge carries the token's stamp, and the buyers pay on the stamp, not the steel. Take the token and the trade is paper. Their buyers are Sith, and Sith don't forgive missed deliveries. I'm not just ending a school. I'm arranging its creditors.

Not one at a time, if they can help it. The circle fights as a set. Staggered, patient, the duelist floating loose to take whoever overextends. Bringing your two again wouldn't shame you. Four against one is their favorite arithmetic. Change the numbers.
Defeat four members of the Forcebane Inner Circle in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Forcebane Overseer's Clearance Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples.
You've defeated four members of the Forcebane Inner Circle. Let me see the Forcebane Overseer's Clearance Token.
Their instructors no longer hold the authority to teach. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master wrote the counters the school now uses. Beat him in the Champion Forge to finish this lesson. Defeat the Forcebane Master in Korriban, Champion Forge. Report back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Champion Forge, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Forcebane Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

My net-man. Bait, blade, and net, and he was the net, the one who closed doors. Best timing I ever hunted beside. When you face him, that's what you're fighting: every escape you'd use, already closed. He'll ask about me. Tell him I kept the rules. He'll know which one I mean.

I recommend two companions against the Forcebane Master. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

The forge heart is his temple now. Heat that bends your sight, one bridge over the crucible, and him at the middle of it, patient as an anvil. Nobody walks off that bridge alone, so don't walk onto it alone. And he will talk. He talks better than I do. If your feet stop moving while he does, your friends are carrying you home.

Defeat the Forcebane Master in Korriban, Champion Forge. Report back to me here in Korriban, Valley Temples; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Forcebane Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The school no longer holds the forge. Keep your timing sharper than your grudges. You've earned the right to train Forcebane. Your final payment is ready.
Go over the job again.
I'll defeat six Forcebane Adepts.
Why a spear against Force users?
How do I get into these caverns?
What's waiting in there besides adepts?
Not today.
Here's the Forcebane Forge Heat Ledger.
Run the second job past me again.
I'll defeat five Forcebane Specialists.
What is a tempering matrix?
How did your counters end up on Korriban?
How do the specialists fight?
Give me a day first.
Here's the Forcebane Sith Tempering Matrix.
Tell me about the warden again.
I'll defeat the Forcebane Warden.
What makes this warden different?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What's it like past the tempering line?
I need to find my two first.
Here's the Forcebane Cracked Anvil Sigil.
Walk me through the circle again.
I'll defeat four members of the Forcebane Inner Circle.
Who are the four?
What does the token actually clear?
How will they come at me?
Let me sharpen up first.
Here's the Forcebane Overseer's Clearance Token.
Tell me about him once more.
I'll face the Forcebane Master and report back.
What was he to you?
How do I beat the man who wrote the rules?
What happens at the heart of the forge?
Not yet. Not until we're ready.
The Forcebane Master is defeated. Here's my report.
